record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.context_brief: Limits of the old-fashioned trace extension method.
record.original_question: Let L^{LEX}_{1,\infty}=H\circ L^{WEYL}_{1,\infty} be the left-hand extension ideal obtained by composing the Hilbert-factorization ideal H with the Weyl-generated ideal L^{WEYL}_{1,\infty}. Show that either (L^{WEYL}_{2,\infty})^{APP}_{2,\infty} is not contained in L^{LEX}_{1,\infty}, or even that the smaller ideal L^{APP}_{1,\infty} is not contained in L^{LEX}_{1,\infty}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in the category of operators acting between arbitrary (complex) Banach spaces. Recall the following constructions of operator ideals.

1. Approximation numbers: for a bounded operator T: X → Y between Banach spaces, the n-th approximation number is
   a_n(T) = inf{ ||T − F|| : F: X → Y, rank(F) < n }.
   The Lorentz-type approximation ideal L^{APP}_{1,∞} consists of all operators T such that
   sup_{n ≥ 1} n · a_n(T) < ∞.
   More generally, L^{APP}_{p,∞} is the class of operators with sup_n n^{1/p} a_n(T) < ∞.

2. Weyl numbers: for T: X → Y, the n-th Weyl number is
   x_n(T) = sup{ a_n(T ∘ A) : A: ℓ_2 → X, ||A|| ≤ 1 }.
   The Weyl-generated ideal L^{WEYL}_{p,∞} consists of all operators with sup_n n^{1/p} x_n(T) < ∞.

3. For an operator ideal A and parameters p,q the "Lorentz-type re-iteration" A^{APP}_{p,∞} denotes the class of operators T whose approximation numbers satisfy a Lorentz-type estimate built from A in the standard way; in particular (L^{WEYL}_{2,∞})^{APP}_{2,∞} is the class of operators T such that sup_n n^{1/2} a_n(T) is controlled in the L^{WEYL}_{2,∞} sense.

4. The Hilbert-factorization ideal H consists of all operators that factor through a Hilbert space:
   T ∈ H(X,Y) ⇔ there exist a Hilbert space K and bounded operators T: X → K, S: K → Y with T = S ∘ R.

5. Define the left-hand extension ideal
   L^{LEX}_{1,∞} := H ∘ L^{WEYL}_{1,∞},
   that is, the ideal of operators that can be written as a composition U ∘ V with V ∈ L^{WEYL}_{1,∞} and U ∈ H.

Problem. Prove that
   (L^{WEYL}_{2,∞})^{APP}_{2,∞} ⊄ L^{LEX}_{1,∞},
or, even stronger, that
   L^{APP}_{1,∞} ⊄ L^{LEX}_{1,∞}.

Equivalently, exhibit a Banach-space operator belonging to L^{APP}_{1,∞} (respectively to (L^{WEYL}_{2,∞})^{APP}_{2,∞}) that does not admit a factorization U ∘ V with V of Weyl-type (1,∞) and U factoring through a Hilbert space.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in a list of open problems on traces of operator ideals over the class of all Banach spaces. No subsequent resolution was located in available sources, so the problem appears to remain open.
